purpose: Allow autonomous causal A1 work after canonical controller qualification without requalifying after each valid work commit, while binding operation to the qualified control identity.

invariants.qualification_transport: CQ remains single-shot, preflight-head-bound and CQ_JOURNAL_ONLY.
invariants.operational_transport: Operational work uses a separate checkpointed transport only after canonical runtime PASS.
invariants.control_identity: The qualified control identity is the set of control-source hashes recorded by host evidence, and every such source must remain byte-identical during operational use.
invariants.authority: No operational checkpoint can expand repo_scope, permissions, A2/A3, promotion, Ready or merge.
invariants.writer: Exactly one write-capable executor per worktree/session.
invariants.git: Normal non-force push only through the protected operational transport.

bootstrap.rationale: CQ4 journal and human adjudication may advance HEAD after the preflight candidate; bootstrap accepts only this bounded bridge while requiring control hashes to remain qualified.

recovery.retry_rule: A failed command may be retried only after an identified causal delta, except read-only reconciliation.
partial_publish: local and remote equal one validated successor of checkpoint => advance checkpoint without a new commit
local is one validated successor and remote remains checkpoint => retry only push/readback

checkpoints.role: progress tracking only; not an authority source

human_gates: controller governance or qualified control-source change
